text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If ya just perk up those ears of yours,
you'll be
able to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Piercin' the sky, shakin' the earth, and
grippin'
your very soul!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's the sound of a festival,
burstin'
with heart and style!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You there, and you! Take a moment and
lend me
your ear!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Born 'n' raised among the real locals, I'm
the
Umamusume with Oi flair! It's me,
the Edo
girl—Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lemme spin ya a tale like no other, of an
all-out
battle of legendary proportions!
The grand
festival of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on me 'til the very end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, Inari One and I are
officially
taking on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume races are largely divided
into two
categories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One is the Twinkle Series, which is
governed by
the URA. These are the
central races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other category comprises races
overseen by
the National Association of
Umamusume, also
known as NAU.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These races—referred to as regional races—are run mainly on dirt at racecourses like Oi, Kasamatsu, and Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One, being associated with the Oi
team, was
expected to run her debut as
a regional racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I just had to try scouting her after
being
captivated by her running.
Eventually, she
developed an interest in
central races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with the support of the people from
her
hometown, Inari One transferred to
Tracen
Academy and signed a contract
with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she and her hometown folks
have put
their trust in me, I can't let any
of them down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With renewed determination, I make my
way to
the training track, when...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Bring it ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the clear skies, Inari One's
booming
voice echoes across the
training track.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The great Inari's burnin' hot today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fierce and sharp, every step she takes
seems to
hammer her raw fighting spirit
into the earth. The
spectacle stirs my
very soul.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Tracen Academy track's in real
proper
shape today. Gotta give the
maintenance folks
props!
choice_data_list: (No matter how many times I see it, it's amazing...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Boss! What the heck? How long ya
been
standin' there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Boss! What the heck? How long ya
been
standin' there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no need to apologize. Figured I'd
get here
a lil' early and do some warmin'
up 'fore ya came.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no needa apologize. Figured I'd
get here a
lil' early and do some warmin'
up before ya came.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Welp, we're finally here! The start of our
quest
through the Twinkle Series! The
long, flowery
road to glory for the great
Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeah! Can't wait to get out there 'n'
race! I'm
gonna send fireworks into the
sky with my victory!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Don't pull any punches with my
trainin'!
choice_data_list: First, let's give it everything in your debut race!
First, let's do our best in your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya know, though... I'm sure gettin' a
lotta stares
today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's this group eyeballin' me since I
started
runnin'. Look, check out the
seats.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so that's the transfer student. She
seems
pretty capable... but a bit rough
around the
edges, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Regional racers really run differently,
don't they?
They say that girl from
Kasamatsu has a pretty
unique form too.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Heh. Let's see how far they'll make it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tch, same ol' story. Scopin' out the new
kid to see
what the big deal is.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit annoying havin' so many eyes
on me, but
nothin' worth fussing over.
This academy doesn't
get many transfers
after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let 'em flap their mouths now. Once
they see me
in a real race, they'll be
eating those words!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't changed a bit since arriving

here—always standing tall and brimming
with
confidence. As her trainer, I need to
rise to the
same level.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! Time to refocus 'n' get back to
the track!
What's the game plan for
today?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A goal? Well, I don't have anything
specific in
mind, but...
choice_data_list: First, let's set some goals for the future.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is huge. I wanna turn that into my own, ultimate festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Then I wanna stand right there at the
heart of the
festival 'n' roar out a
declaration!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Here I am, Inari One! I'm the Edo Uma,
born 'n'
bred in Oi!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, for real? We must think alike, eh,
Boss?
choice_data_list: That's a great goal, very like you, Inari.
That's a great goal, so like you, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, izzat right? We must think alike,
eh, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Kay, with that set, let's get right to
trainin'! I
can't sit still anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with increased determination,
Inari One
and I begin our training
session.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I worked up a real sweat today! Can't
wait for a
great bath after this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You too, Boss! Let's keep it up
tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You too, Boss! Let's keep it up
tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Inariii!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look at you! You were more fired up
than usual,
hm? ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Like Creek said, that was some
powerful
footwork.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two Umamusume who call out to
Inari One
are two runners destined to
become her future
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One is Super Creek, recognized for her
stamina
and tactical prowess, with all the
makings of a
future champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other is Oguri Cap, who, like Inari
One,
transferred from the regional
circuit and has
slowly been turning
heads with her extraordinary
talent.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you guys've really been tearin' it
up too,
though! I can tell jus' by lookin'
at ya!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. ♪ Well, seeing you putting in
so much
effort made me realize I can't
afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We might be competing in the same
races after
all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Since I come from from Kasamatsu, it's
been
really great seeing another
regional racer giving it
their all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But just so you know... I won't hold back
if we end
up competing in the same race.
I have no
intention of losing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear! Comin' at me
with a
challenge right off the bat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to the day we all put
on one
helluva festival!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. See you around then.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If you'll excuse us. ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I really can't afford to fall behind. I feel like I'm the one walkin' away here with the bigger motivation boost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she mentions it, Inari One saw
Oguri
Cap and Super Creek racing when
she first visited
Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't doubt they'll give her that extra
push by
becoming her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! I almost forgot! Do you have a
lil' time
after this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! I almost forgot! Do you have a
lil' time
after this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Annnd, we're done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following our training session, Inari One
changes
clothes and proceeds to carry
several tatami mats
into my office, laying
them out on the floor like
an island.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss, but I jus' can't relax without
these.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss, but I jus' can't relax without
these.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Since I'll be spendin' a lotta time in here
with ya
from now on, I figured I'd go
ahead 'n' borrow a
bit of floor space!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's share a drink to mark the
occasion.
I'll brew us some tea.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I said this before, but I'm really lookin'
forward to
workin' together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us sit on the tatami mats,
steaming
cups of tea raised, and make a
vow for our
journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We share a final moment of peace
before we
throw ourselves into the war
zone of the Twinkle
Series!
